author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
In LAIKA Studios' puppet department, Adam Savage takes a crash course in puppet-making techniques the studio developed for making Wildwood's bird characters. Fabrication leads walk Adam through their process of making thousands of stop-motion feathers for the film, and demonstrate the unique materials used to let bird puppets move and animate with breathtaking realism. 

Wildwood is in theaters now and tickets are available at: https://wildwoodmovie.com/
Adam Savage Meets the Stop-Motion Puppets of LAIKA Studios: https://youtu.be/9stm18DFD08
Adam Savage Tours the LAIKA Studios Model Shop: https://youtu.be/joYBiW9K07s
How LAIKA Studios Made Their Most Advanced Stop-Motion Puppet: https://youtu.be/1psOPPZn0k8
